checks.name: Boot with four founders and no external requests
40-year checkpoint restores 29 people in four settlements
Person selection displays needs, utility scores, memories and family
Pointer drag and wheel change town camera
A building on the canvas opens its live inspector
Local-storage action reports success or unavailable-storage fallback, never crashes
Desktop has no horizontal page overflow
390px mobile canvas remains available and does not overflow
Mobile observation sheet and person selection

limitations: Container Chromium blocks file:// and loopback navigation. The identical standalone HTML was tested using page.set_content. Browser-local persistence success and normal file launching were not verified in this runner.
Only Chromium was tested; Safari/Firefox and real touch hardware were not tested.
